description: This file defines a Catalyst controller class for managing 'Meal' entities within a web application. It includes methods for creating, updating, deleting, and managing dishes associated with meals, with access control and JSON responses.

classes.name: Coocook::Controller::Meal
classes.description: Catalyst controller class for managing meal-related actions.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Handles POST request to create a new meal related to a project, returning JSON data.

methods.name: base
methods.description: Captures a meal by ID for subsequent chained actions, or detaches if not found.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Handles POST request to update meal details, returning updated data as JSON.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Handles POST request to delete a meal if deletable, or returns an error message.

methods.name: delete_dishes
methods.description: Handles POST request to delete dishes associated with a meal.

methods.name: redirect
methods.description: Private method to redirect to the project edit page.
